summary: Draft is largely sound; word split and grams hold up. Main fixes: (1) bare sandhi = 'peace' (Book 7 / glossary 8.5, 9.7, 12.5, ch01-ch02), 'treaty' kept only for the named kinds, whose compounds now follow glossary 12.1/12.5 ('treaties of one submitting with his army/treasury/a region'); (2) Hindi vyasana-yaugapadya used विपत्ति instead of व्यसन (u15); (3) u35 Hindi locative contradicts the dual nom./acc. gram; (4) dvaidhī-bhūta per glossary 7.2; (5) asya (u7) is genitive, not dative-like; (6) the 'paśyedd' flags in u13 and u17 are spurious (e-text writes -d dh- as 'dd h', also in 7.1/7.7) and should be deleted by hand; the āmena-ahatam flag in u4 is kept (printed 'ahatam' with short a is a real anomaly). Units 20, 25-30, 32-36 stay low/uncertain as drafted; no regrouping suggested. Counts: 2 error, 51 minor, 51 machine patches.
